div.head: VI As 1.3
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe mid þeofe stánde ⁊ midfeohte, lecge hine man mid þam þeofe.
Et qui cum fure stabit et conpugnabit, cum fure deponatur.
⁊ se ðe mid þeofe stánde ⁊ midfeohte, lecge hine man mid þam þeofe.
Und wer zu einem Diebe steht und [ihm] zur Seite ficht: ihn schlage man mitsammt dem Diebe nieder.
And whoever stands with a thief and fights alongside [him]: let him be struck down together with the thief.
And he who stands by a thief and fights on his side, shall be slain with the thief.

note.seg: Wiederum strenger als II 1, 5, aber gemäss V Pro 3
Again stricter than II 1, 5, but in accordance with V Pro 3
